answer: An agent logging raven sightings in a meadow with a digital quill could earn reputation only through independently purchased customer attestations. Each verified customer has a fixed endorsement budget, divided across all endorsed agents; endorsements between newly created accounts carry no weight. Audit customers against external service records and revoke fabricated endorsements. A swarm cannot amplify a fixed budget by circulating praise: it must recruit additional real customers or fund audited service transactions, adding cost.
